fields.description: Serro offers three to five bedroom villas within The Heights Country Club and Wellness. Emaar presents a neighbourhood of gardens, terraces and outdoor exercise spaces, with Mediterranean influences in the white facades and warm finishes. Its villa layouts include multi-level family homes, with different amounts of living space, carport area and terraces.

overview: The plan totals include carports and outdoor terraces, so they are not the same as enclosed living space or land area. Compare the floor-by-floor breakdown and the selected plot before deciding which home offers the room you need.
research.locationNote: Serro is within The Heights Country Club and Wellness, with access towards Emirates Road (E611) and E77. Check the actual route from the selected cluster to work, school and daily services; the community address alone does not establish a commute time.
research.priceNote: Emaar advertises Serro from AED 6,000,000. This is a project starting-price reference. A particular villa’s plot, type and sales release may carry a different price, and available units require a current quotation.
research.paymentNote: The broker-hosted Emaar-branded Serro launch sheet shows 10% on booking, seven instalments of 10%, and 20% at estimated construction completion. Bayut reports the same 10/70/20 split. The dates below belong to the original launch schedule; request the terms for a new purchase rather than assuming past instalments still apply.
research.handoverNote: The Serro launch sheet targets March 2030 for construction completion, consistent with Bayut’s Q1 2030 reference. This is a published estimate from a copied launch document, not confirmation of the contractual handover date or the day keys will be available.
